title: Hidden in Plain Blocks
description: Allows players to hide items in flower pots.
body:
Allows players to hide items in flower pots.
Has been open-sourced on [GitHub](https://github.com/yiyuyan/HiddenInPlainBlocks/releases/tag/1.0).

After installing this mod, you can use Shift + Right-click on the flower pot to put the items in your hand in the flower pot.

You can use Shift + Right-click to remove the items in the flower pot again.

At the same time, when the flower pot is destroyed, the items inside will also fall.

Tip: This mod is compatible with the TACZ mod, and now you can hide the guns in the flower pot!
